name: ask-satoshi
description: Ask Satoshi — a free, no-sign-up chatbot grounded in the BSV-AIO-MCP knowledge server and Satoshi Nakamoto's historical writings.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta --restart-tries 3 --restart-after 1000 "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
